text.en:
Section one of Executive Order No. 352, dated
October 6, 1950, is hereby amended by increasing and set-
ting up new ceiling prices for Hills Bros. coffee, as follows:
Coffee roasted:
Hills Bros. Coffee....

The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include the
7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of March, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and
of the Independence of the Philppines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
